insert.foreach: INSERT INTO students_courses(student_id, course_name, course_start_at, course_end_at, deleted) VALUES( #{course.studentId}, #{course.courseName}, #{course.courseStartAt}, #{course.courseEndAt}, #{course.deleted} )

update.foreach: UPDATE students_courses SET course_name = #{course.courseName}, course_start_at = #{course.courseStartAt}, course_end_at = #{course.courseEndAt}, deleted = #{course.deleted} WHERE id = #{course.id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, course_name AS courseName, course_start_at AS courseStartAt, course_end_at AS courseEndAt, deleted FROM students_courses WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = FALSE
